rank: Exclude any protection failure if possible. Rank by total passed gates across two seeds, then least maximum relative threshold excess, then least worst-seed summed event IAE ratio versus N, then lower ordinary torque RMS, then fixed parameter ordering.
linear_x8_trigger: At a selected filter only, x4 ranks best, and versus x2 at least one of full RMS, ordinary RMS, summed event IAE improves >=5% on both seeds with none of the three deteriorating >5% on either seed.
second_order_trigger: Run only if no first-order SFC passes all five gates on both calibration seeds.
holdout_selection: Keep at most two distinct filter settings ranked on calibration. Keep only passing settings if any pass both seeds, otherwise validate the top two as diagnostics. Freeze before first holdout run.
delay_gate_reference: Pair all displacement and spectral thresholds against N at the same delay. Retain the same-seed historical rho=0.25 SFC at 0 ms as the torque-cost reference.
psd: Welch fs=1000 Hz, Hann 2000 samples, 1000 overlap, constant detrend, segment-count weighting over ordinary spans. Rectangular 0.5-Hz bin sums. Include the 500-Hz bin in residual only.
event_iae: Trapezoidal integral of absolute original physical Y samples, including both grid-aligned endpoints as in archived scoring. Report declared interval duration. Recovery time N/A.
